blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Light Rail Transit 1 (LRT-1) will implement an adjusted holiday schedule from November 16 to 18 in line with the special non-working days declared for the 49th Asean Summit, its operator reminded the public on Sunday. The Light Rail Manila Corporation (LRMC) advised passengers to take note of the adjusted operating hours across all LRT-1 stations during the three-day period.
